verdict.rationale: Community users say Hoppscotch works without a login (comm-4) and that an offline workspace exists, though only one workspace is available offline and its data cannot be pointed at a local directory (comm-5). The installable PWA and desktop app (gh-7, docs-27, docs-29) suggest local use, but no first-party doc explicitly describes an offline-first local workspace. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of offline mode and local workspace storage, support for multiple offline workspaces, file/directory-based workspace data.
